defect: (1) The certifier spawned the Stage 3G tests with an explicit --test-reporter=tap while the canonical runner already puts --test-reporter=tap in NODE_OPTIONS; node --test refused two reporters without matching destinations (ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE), so the tests never started: TESTS_PASS=false with 0 pass / 0 fail. Run standalone under the same runtime the same tests pass 24/24. (2) Found while preparing the certification commit: the Stage 3F inheritance section recorded the full list of files changed since the Stage 3F freeze certification commit, so every later commit would change the certificate and no --check could reproduce it after Stage 3G.3 began.
fix: (1) pass --test-reporter=tap only when NODE_OPTIONS does not already carry one; (2) diff only Stage 3F-protected paths (Stage 3F artifacts, docs, scripts, modules, tests, and the core / Forge / symmetric Forge / reproducibility / check-mode infrastructure) and record only protected changes; the freeze-discipline check accepts a post-generation change to a listed evaluation file only from the recorded before bytes to the recorded after bytes; the certifier requires the recomputed scientific sections to equal the preserved first run exactly (AMENDMENT_001_SCIENTIFIC_INVARIANCE).
scope: test-runner invocation and amendment verification only; no measurement, model, plan, threshold, rule, seed, partition or evaluation code path changed
